{{Quote|If you ask me, I don't think C'baoth's ever happy with anything. ''[&hellip;]'' I've never met someone so full of himself.''"<br />"''I had an instructor at the institute just like him. ''[&hellip;]'' One night some of the students sneaked into his office, disassembled his desk, and reassembled it in the refresher station down the hall. I thought he was going to pop every blood vessel in his face when he saw it.|[[Reactor Tech]] [[Chas Uliar]] and Brace Tarkosa|<ref name="OBF" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''institute instructor''' instructed the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Brace Tarkosa]].<ref name="OBF" /> By [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] to [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].</ref> several of the instructor's students entered his office and dismantled his desk, which they rebuilt in a [[Refresher/Legends|refresher]] station. Tarkosa believed that once the teacher saw the desk in the refresher, he would be apoplectic.<ref name="OBF" /> In 27 BBY,<ref name="Date" /> Tarkosa compared the teacher to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Jorus C'baoth]], which the Human and his colleagues believed was while aboard the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Scout/Legends|exploration]] and colonization [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] ''[[Outbound Flight]]''.<ref name="OBF" />

==Behind the scenes==
The institute instructor was mentioned in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[2006]] novel [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']].<ref name="OBF" />
